scoring_basis: docs/omega_variables.md four properties (Clarity, Boundedness, Irreducibility, Unlockability) + Omega-type resolution-mode match. SOUND = all four PASS AND type_correct AND routes OUT (resolution exits to measurement/definition/stakeholder).

type_modes.preference: value judgment by those bearing consequences

ledger.name: reading_contest_axes
ledger.reason: Resolution routes to measurement of three named axes; selects among readings -> enables next step.

ledger.name: successor_state_representation
ledger.reason: Approach mixes empirical alignment with an explicitly conceptual 'is the successor state the legitimate heir' sub-question; labelled empirical but resolution mode is hybrid leaning conceptual/legitimacy.

ledger.name: mathematical_inevitability_vs_policy_choice_framing
ledger.reason: Pure framework-selection (inevitable-math frame vs policy-conditional frame); resolution is definitional choice that re-routes classification.

ledger.name: amendment_gatekeeping_legitimacy
ledger.reason: 'Is it legitimate' is a normative value judgment whose correctness depends on whose values apply; routes to stakeholder/normative authority.

ledger.name: authentication_necessity_vs_sufficiency
ledger.reason: Comparative analysis of historical juristic practice = measurement/observation; resolves the tangled_rope vs rope boundary.

ledger.name: kernel_reading_assignment
ledger.reason: Internal-consistency test of a reading = conceptual coherence check; resolution is framework adjudication (coherent vs collapses).

ledger.name: interpretive_authority_source_under_contestation
ledger.reason: Textual analysis of which authority-source the reading claims = framework/definition selection; determines stability under challenge.

ledger.name: fiat_enforcement_apparatus_maturity
ledger.reason: Timeline / cross-country comparison = measurement; resolves cause-vs-consequence weighting of the shift.

ledger.name: dharmasastra_beneficiary_consciousness
ledger.reason: Textual + behavioral evidence of beneficiary consciousness = observation; routes to a different change roadmap. (Consequence concedes harm identical either way; still unlocks the roadmap distinction.)

ledger.name: identity_locking_reversibility
ledger.reason: Longitudinal tracking of exits = measurement; resolves whether suppression/extraction exceeds authored values.

ledger.name: technology_determinism_historiography
ledger.reason: Examination of documentary evidence (letters, economic decisions) = observation; resolves mountain vs tangled_rope reclassification.

ledger.name: constitutional_authorization_ambiguity
ledger.reason: Textual/doctrinal analysis of whether the Constitution authorizes the doctrine = framework/definitional interpretation; resolves rope-adjacent vs snare.

ledger.name: contingent_faculty_visibility_in_evaluation
ledger.reason: Departmental rubric audit + interviews = measurement; resolves theatre_ratio and snare strengthening.

ledger.name: licensing_transaction_cost_equilibrium
ledger.reason: Empirical study of fee/timescale thresholds = measurement; supports snare classification / regulatory threshold.

ledger.name: committer_frame__hierarchical_vs_pastoral_readings
ledger.reason: Largely restates already-authored structural deltas (epsilon, victim sets, enforcement given for both readings); the 'omega' is answered in its own approach text -> not irreducible/external, it documents rather than blocks.

ledger.name: absolute_prohibition_foreclosure
ledger.reason: Comparative treaty interpretation = framework selection (foreclosure vs coexistence); resolves whether kernel contest is resolvable or permanent.

ledger.name: global_south_development_path_constraint
ledger.reason: 'Legitimately constrained' is a value/allocation judgment across stakeholders; routes to consequence-bearer decision. (Approach lists empirical aids but the core block is preference.)

ledger.name: term_extension_public_goods_justification
ledger.reason: Textual + economic-evidence analysis of actual justifications = measurement; resolves public-scaffold vs pure-extraction.

ledger.name: kernel_reading_contestation_space
ledger.reason: Approach enumerates the three readings' epsilon/beneficiary/type already authored; question 'what are the differences' is answered in-line -> restates the constraint set, no exiting resolution.

ledger.name: international_enforcement_leverage
ledger.reason: Tracking tariff/diaspora/geopolitical activity = measurement; resolves whether balanced reading stays viable or drifts.

ledger.name: messianic_timeline_indeterminacy
ledger.reason: Framework question (genuine maintenance vs perpetual deferral) resolved by tracing how the community frames the suspension = framework selection; pushes piton vs scaffold.

ledger.name: reading_foreclosure_vs_coexistence
ledger.reason: Political-structural analysis of whether one state can hold both readings = framework adjudication; resolves temporary-compromise vs permanent-settlement.

ledger.name: prerogative_suppression_in_implementation
ledger.reason: Historical analysis of how authority defended constraints = observation; resolves structural vs internalized suppression (architecturally enforced vs fragile).

ledger.name: stress_inoculation_vs_stress_trauma_boundary
ledger.reason: Definitional question (what does 'real catastrophe' mean for the constraint) = definition/framework selection; resolves coexistence vs foreclosure with proxy reading. (Cites neuroscience as aid but core is definitional.)

ledger.name: funding_concentration_reversibility
ledger.reason: Question/approach are empirical (policy experiments measuring output quality, citation patterns, resistance = measurement) not a value judgment; labelled preference but resolution mode is empirical.

ledger.name: kernel_reading_contest
ledger.reason: Consequence concedes 'unresolvable within this framework' and prescribes generating all three readings -> no exiting resolution; restates the kernel contest rather than blocking on an external resolvable datum.

ledger.name: enforceability_of_theological_veto_in_secular_governance
ledger.reason: Observation of enforcement in named jurisdictions = measurement; resolves theatrical-vs-real enforcement / structural authority.

ledger.name: kernel_reading_foreclosure_test
ledger.reason: Logical axiom-compatibility analysis = framework selection (foreclosure vs coexistence); resolves triadic-conflict vs institutional-contest.

ledger.name: native_speaker_identity_lock_mechanism
ledger.reason: Sociological interview/longitudinal study = measurement; identifying lock type clarifies escapable vs constitutional victimhood.

ledger.name: institutional_gap_persistence
ledger.reason: Ethnographic/historical study of dispute resolution in institutional gaps = observation; resolves whether the displacement reading is supported.
